clauses.clause: When this creature dies, it deals 3 damage to any target.
clauses.evidence: [this card is dealt lethal damage]: trigger [0]; 'ask target: [you_bear, you_giant, opp_flier, opp_tapped, opp_bear, opp_giant, you, opp]' (every creature and both players; no artifact/enchantment); 'you_bear is dealt 3 damage (by card/DEAL_DAMAGE)', it dies. [attacks and opp_giant blocks it]: combat death triggers the same. Other creatures dying and non-lethal damage do not trigger. Tree equals the compiler's parse (B2a-pitchburn-devils). Planeswalker part of 'any target' (no planeswalker on the probe board): pack pitchburn_devils_dies_hits_planeswalker, the dies trigger targets an opponent's Basri Ket at loyalty 5 and leaves it at 2: PASS (kills a mutant without the planeswalker branch).
